name: International General Insurance (IGIC)
teaser: At $24.81 the shares trade 9.8% above my Base value of $22.59, a downside of 9.0%. International General Insurance (IGI) is a good specialty underwriter with no financial debt, but the price already assumes a return on equity of about 15.4% in the long run, against the 14.0% in my Base. The first half combined ratio of 92.2% hides a second quarter of 95.1%, and the half depends on $30.6 million of favorable reserve development that arrived in the first quarter. Confidence is C and the required margin of safety is 40%, which puts the maximum buy price at $13.55. Hold for holders, watchlist for new money. Third quarter results on November 3 are not in this analysis.
llms: Bermuda based specialty insurer and reinsurer, valued on a price to book model with a return on equity transition, cross-checked with normalized earnings and a reserve stressed net asset test; the first half combined ratio of 92.2% leans on first quarter reserve releases. Bear 12.04, Base 22.59, Bull 32.33. Verdict HOLD at 24.81 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price 13.55.
